title: About Trinetra Digital Solution
content: Trinetra Digital Solution is a premier digital transformation & growth agency based in Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh. We empower businesses with cutting-edge Website Development, SEO, Google & Meta Ads, WhatsApp Automation, Custom CRM systems, and AI Business Automation solutions to multiply revenue and automate growth.

title: Trinetra Mission & Vision
content: Our Mission is to digitize and automate 10,000+ businesses across India by delivering enterprise-grade software, high-converting digital marketing, and intelligent AI automation at honest, transparent prices. Our Vision is to be India's most trusted digital growth partner for SMBs and enterprises alike.

title: Leadership & Founder
content: Trinetra Digital Solution was founded by visionary technology innovators and digital marketers dedicated to bridging the gap between local enterprise potential and modern digital capability. Our core team consists of expert full-stack developers, SEO strategists, and AI system architects.

title: Trinetra Services Overview
content:
Trinetra Digital Solution offers 8 core technology & marketing services:
1. Custom Website Development (React/Next.js)
2. Search Engine Optimization (Local & Global SEO)
3. Google Ads & Meta (Facebook/Instagram) Paid Marketing
4. WhatsApp Business API & Chatbot Automation
5. Custom CRM & Lead Management Systems
6. AI Automation & Workflow Integration
7. AI Avatar Video Creation & Personalization
8. Social Media Marketing & Business Automation.

title: Custom Website Development
content: We design and build lightning-fast, ultra-responsive, high-converting websites tailored for your business. Stack includes Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and secure backend integration. Features include 100% mobile responsiveness, SEO-ready structure, instant page load speed, custom graphics, and integrated contact/lead capture forms.

title: Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
content: Dominate Google search results with our outcome-driven SEO campaigns. We handle technical SEO, page speed optimization, high-intent keyword target selection, Google Business Profile (GBP) ranking for local clients, content strategy, and quality backlink generation to drive high-converting organic leads to your business 24/7.

title: Google Ads & PPC Campaigns
content: Get targeted buyer leads from day one with data-backed Google Search, Display, and Video PPC campaigns. We optimize cost per click (CPC), craft high-converting ad copy, set up conversion tracking, build dedicated landing pages, and continuously refine negative keywords to maximize your ROI.

title: Meta (Facebook & Instagram) Advertising
content: Turn casual scrollers into paying customers. We run laser-targeted Meta ad campaigns leveraging custom audiences, lookalike modeling, engaging video creatives, catalog ads, and direct WhatsApp lead generation flows for high conversion rates.

title: WhatsApp API & Chatbot Automation
content: Automate 90% of customer support and sales queries on WhatsApp. We provide Official Meta WhatsApp Business API verification, automated auto-responders, multi-agent inbox, drip campaign sequences, appointment reminders, and automated instant lead notifications.

title: Custom CRM & Lead Management
content: Stop losing prospective clients in spreadsheets. Trinetra builds custom lightweight, high-speed CRM software fitted directly to your sales workflow. Includes real-time lead ingestion from Facebook/Google/Website, automated status stages (New, Contacted, Qualified, Closed), staff assignment, and analytics.

title: AI Business Automation & Agents
content: Supercharge operational efficiency with intelligent AI workflows. We build autonomous AI voice call bots, internal knowledge retrieval assistants, automated document processors, intelligent email auto-replies, and custom AI chatbots operating 24/7 without manual intervention.

title: AI Avatar & Video Production
content: Scale video content production without expensive cameras or studio shoots. We generate hyper-realistic AI digital avatars for brand storytelling, automated multilingual video reels, training videos, and dynamic ad creatives.

title: Social Media Marketing (SMM)
content: Build an engaging online brand presence across Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and Facebook. We manage high-quality post design, short-form viral reels, content calendar planning, community engagement, and brand reputation.

title: Business Process Automation
content: Eliminate tedious repetitive manual tasks. We integrate your software stack (Forms, Google Sheets, WhatsApp, CRM, Accounting, Email) into seamless automated pipelines that run flawlessly on autopilot.

content:
Typical project turnaround times:

• E-Commerce / Custom Portal: 15 to 25 business days.
• WhatsApp API & Chatbot: 2 to 4 business days.
• Custom CRM / AI Workflows: 10 to 20 business days.
We provide strict milestones and weekly status reports.

title: Payment Structure & Modes
content: We accept payments via UPI, NEFT/RTGS, Bank Transfer, and Credit/Debit cards. Standard payment structure is 50% advance upon project initiation and 50% final balance upon launch approval. Official GST invoices are provided for all projects.

title: Results & Performance Guarantees
content: While search engines (Google) and ad platforms (Meta) control external auction algorithms, we guarantee 100% adherence to white-hat industry standards, continuous ad budget optimization, transparent analytics, and dedicated support until milestones are satisfied.

title: Handling Price & Budget Concerns
content: At Trinetra, we prioritize Return on Investment (ROI) over cheap cut-rate work. Low-cost websites often lack security, mobile optimization, and conversion engineering—costing you thousands in lost buyers. We design solutions tailored to pay for themselves through new customer acquisition.

title: Already Have a Website / Agency?
content: Great! We offer comprehensive Website Audit & Redesign services. If your existing site is slow, outdated, or not generating qualified leads, we can modernize it with Next.js speed, rebuild your conversion funnel, or layer on WhatsApp AI automation to convert existing traffic.

title: Business Policies & NDAs
content: All client source code, data, and business leads remain 100% your exclusive intellectual property. We happily execute mutual Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs) prior to project kickoff to ensure total confidentiality.

title: Post-Launch Support & Maintenance
content: Every project includes 30 to 90 days of complimentary post-launch support and maintenance. We provide ongoing website maintenance, server monitoring, security updates, content updates, and dedicated ticketing support.
